day_shape: 88 items: Rubio tells G7 sanctions/naval blockade make major strikes unneeded while Qatar claims a two-week US-Iran diplomatic window, IRGC claims a third tanker explosion in Hormuz and unveils an underground missile city, Canada reimposes sanctions on 11 Iranian entities, and Khamenei hosts first-night Fatimid mourning.

threads.label: US-Iran diplomacy and pressure track
threads.summary: Rubio told G7 foreign ministers in Paris that US sanctions and a naval blockade on Iran are working well enough that Trump need not resume major combat operations, while Hegseth said he would repeat the earlier strikes. Qatar's PM told G7 counterparts Doha had secured a roughly two-week window to pursue a US-Iran deal; Iran's SNSC secretary Razaei denied talks were under way.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker incidents
threads.summary: Defa Press and IRIB said a third "smuggling tanker" struck a naval mine and exploded in the eastern Strait of Hormuz, with images released of two others burning. The Jerusalem Post reported continuing tanker attacks in the Strait as oil prices hit two-month lows.

threads.label: Nuclear file, sanctions and Araghchi letter
threads.summary: Canada reimposed sanctions on 11 Iranian entities over the nuclear programme and non-cooperation with the IAEA, and the FBI added an IRGC member accused in the Bolton plot to its Most Wanted Terrorists list. Iran's FM Araghchi wrote to the UN Secretary-General, Security Council president and IAEA chief demanding condemnation of a US State Department $20m reward offer.

threads.label: IRGC missile city and China ties
threads.summary: Iran International reported the IRGC unveiled a new underground missile facility with senior commanders touring the site, and Speaker Qalibaf called the "new missile city" a message to enemies. Qalibaf separately said Khamenei's directives on China are specific, while China's ambassador to Israel rejected as "baseless" claims Beijing aided Iran's missile and nuclear programmes.

threads.label: France cyberattack row and UK base moves
threads.summary: French FM Barrot said Paris is weighing undisclosed measures against Iran over IRGC-blamed cyberattacks that overheated freezers in around 700 supermarkets, with Araghchi dismissing France as "incapable of even managing refrigerators." The WSJ reported the US moved tankers and tiltrotor aircraft out of RAF Mildenhall over an Iran threat, the second UK base thinned since a suspected plot at RAF Fairford.

threads.label: Khamenei-hosted Fatimid mourning cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted a heavy cycle of material from the first night of Fatimid mourning ceremonies at Zinabiyya, including Quran recitation by Seyyed Ahmad Moqimi, elegies by Abbas Heydarzadeh and Hajj Mansour Arzi, and a sermon by Hojjatoleslam Aslani. Defa Press separately reported a funeral procession for 350 unidentified martyrs across Iran.

threads.label: Israel, Gaza and Lebanon
threads.summary: Netanyahu told the Knesset the only way to remove Iran's "existential threat" is the downfall of the Ayatollah regime, while his office said Israel has facilitated a Gaza winterization plan after Board of Peace and UNICEF criticism, which cited rejected stormwater repair equipment. Macron is pushing a new European military presence in southern Lebanon, which Israel is expected to oppose; the IDF reported enforcement operations against four illegal outposts near Burqa, Wadi Rahim and Jalud.

events.summary_en: 21 November marks the anniversary of the martyrdom of Brigadier General Shahid Hassan Tehrani Moghaddam, father of Iran's missiles, and is named Aerospace Day of the Guards. The knowledge, faith and infinite sacrifice of that honourable martyr form the foundation of our power today across the skies of the Islamic homeland. That elevated shahid, with a vision beyond the horizon, opened the path to reaching the peaks of advanced technology in the world from within limitations, leaving behind a lasting legacy of Iran's defence power. Fighters of Islam in the Guards Aerospace Force, by consolidating national power, brought the fruits of the ceaseless efforts of the martyrs of this force to the surface, and at the most difficult moments stood firmly in the field of science and action.

events.summary_en: Public Relations of the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Naval Force: The third smuggling tanker on an unauthorised route in the Strait of Hormuz exploded this afternoon after striking a naval mine. This tanker has been burning in the eastern part of the Strait of Hormuz, and the smoke from this explosion and fire has engulfed the sky of the Strait of Hormuz. After the destruction of radar systems and coastal navigation assistance by the US smugglers' military in the south of the Strait of Hormuz, these tankers are attempting to pass through the illegal route of the Strait of Hormuz at multiple times the risk compared to before. Due to attempts to traverse hazardous and illegal routes, they strike naval mines.

events.title: France warns Iran of retaliation over IRGC hack of supermarket freezers
events.summary: France is weighing measures against Iran, some of which it may never make public, over cyberattacks it blames on the Revolutionary Guards that made refrigerators and freezers overheat in about 700 supermarkets, Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot said on Tuesday.

events.title: US moves aircraft out of second British base over Iran threat - WSJ
events.summary: The US military moved tankers and tiltrotor aircraft out of RAF Mildenhall in eastern England on Monday over a threat from Iran, the Wall Street Journal reported, the second British base it has thinned out since a suspected Iran-linked plot at RAF Fairford in September.

events.title: Iraq cancels Iran football team’s flight to Basra at last minute
events.summary: Iraq’s government announced shortly before Iran’s national football team was due to fly to Basra on Tuesday that the flight could not go ahead.

events.title: Canada reimposes sanctions on 11 Iranian entities it delisted under nuclear deal
events.summary: Canada on Tuesday reimposed sanctions on 11 Iranian entities, including the national oil and tanker companies and four major banks, that it had taken off its list in 2016 under the nuclear deal, citing their support for Iran’s nuclear and ballistic missile programs.

events.title: Trump’s Iran diplomacy faces a test: Can both sides claim victory?
events.summary: President Donald Trump’s talks with Qatar’s prime minister come amid a renewed diplomatic push to end the Iran war, but securing terms both Washington and Tehran can present as a victory remains a central obstacle, analysts told Iran International.

events.title: Imposition of Special Measure Prohibiting the Transmittal of Funds Involving MEXC Global
events.summary: FinCEN is issuing notice of an order, pursuant to section 9714(a) of the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act (Pub. L. 116- 283), as amended by section 6106(b) of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022 (Pub. L. 117-81), finding that MEXC Global--including any of its subsidiaries, branches, and offices, as well as any successor entities, operating in any jurisdiction outside of the United States--is a financial institution operating outside of the United States of primary money laundering concern in connection with Russian illicit finance and prohibiting certain transmittals of funds involving MEXC Global.
